# Printing Press CLI auth-model spike

**Date:** 2026-05-29
**Question (Part 2 design, Milestone 0):** Do Printing-Press-generated CLIs self-refresh OAuth tokens like `gog`, or do they expect a pre-supplied live token? This sets the default `refresh_owner` for the CLI-actor catalog.
**Method:** Inspected real generated output in `github.com/mvanhorn/printing-press-library` ("Official library of CLIs generated by the CLI Printing Press"). Read the `internal/config/config.go`, `internal/cli/auth.go`, and `internal/oauth/*.go` of multiple OAuth and key-only providers. (The generator itself requires Claude Code + an LLM and runs multi-phase; reading already-generated output is the cheaper, more reliable evidence.)

## Verdict

**PP CLIs share ONE uniform auth contract that is simultaneously self-refreshing (Actor A) and env-injectable (Actor B).** Refresh-ownership is a per-integration *wiring toggle*, not a property of the binary.

## Evidence

### Uniform persisted-token contract (every CLI)

All inspected CLIs define the same config struct + persistence, regardless of provider:

- `outlook-calendar/internal/config/config.go:20-22` — `AccessToken` / `RefreshToken` / `TokenExpiry` TOML fields; `SaveTokens(clientID, clientSecret, accessToken, refreshToken, expiry)` at `:101`; `ClearTokens()` at `:110`; `save()` writes `os.WriteFile(c.Path, data, 0o600)` under `MkdirAll(dir, 0o700)` at `:117-126`.
- `figma/internal/config/config.go:21-23, 129-154` — identical struct + `SaveTokens` + `0o600` write.
- `notion/internal/config/config.go:20-21, 113-138` — identical struct + `SaveTokens` + `0o600` write, even though Notion is a long-lived-key provider (its refresh fields just stay empty).

### Self-refresh (Actor A) — OAuth providers

- **Outlook (device-code):** `internal/oauth/device.go` — `RequestDeviceCode()` (:108), `PollToken()` with `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code` (:169-232), and `RefreshToken()` with `grant_type=refresh_token` (:258-322) that handles Microsoft's refresh-token rotation ("Microsoft rotates refresh tokens; if the response omits one, reuse the [previous]", :319-322). Comment at :34-35: `offline_access` scope is what makes Azure return a refresh_token.
- **Figma (auth-code):** `internal/cli/auth.go` — `newAuthLoginCmd` (:38) exchanges `grant_type=authorization_code` (:131), then `cfg.SaveTokens(...)` (:168). `newAuthStatusCmd` reports `"Token expired (will auto-refresh on next request)"` when expiry passed and a refresh token is present (:216-217).

This is the same model as `gog` (login flow + persisted refresh token + auto-refresh), differing only in storage format (TOML file vs `gog`'s 99designs keyring).

### Env override (Actor B) — every CLI

The verbatim convention appears in every config.go:

> `// Env-var token wins over file-stored AccessToken (env > config convention).`

— `notion/internal/config/config.go:88`, `figma/...:104`, `outlook-calendar/...:89`. The provider env vars: `NOTION_TOKEN`, `FIGMA_CLIENT_SECRET`, `OUTLOOK_CALENDAR_TOKEN`, `LINEAR_API_KEY`, `JIRA_API_TOKEN`/`JIRA_CLIENT_SECRET`/`JIRA_TOKEN_URL`, `CLICKUP_AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN`. Setting the env token short-circuits the persisted file.

### Auth-model spread (it adapts to the provider)

| Provider | Auth model | Self-refresh? |
|---|---|---|
| Notion, Linear, ClickUp | long-lived API key / PAT via env | n/a (no expiry) |
| Figma | OAuth authorization_code | yes (auto-refresh) |
| Jira | OAuth (client secret + token URL) | yes |
| Outlook Calendar/Email | OAuth device-code | yes (rotation-aware) |

## Implications for the Integration Registry design

1. **Actor A is the default** for CLI integrations — seed the `0600` TOML file (access + refresh + expiry + client) and the CLI self-refreshes forever. No `lightbulb_rematerialize` loop, no Nango refresh.
2. **Actor B is a free per-integration toggle** on the same binary — set `<PROVIDER>_TOKEN` instead of materializing the file.
3. **Actor A requires seeding the OAuth client** (`SaveTokens(clientID, clientSecret, …)`); device-code providers are public-client (clientID only).
4. **Nango's continuous refresh is largely redundant for CLI actors.** This reopens the `direct_oauth + Actor A` (no Nango vault) vs `nango + Actor B` (Nango owns refresh, token off-disk) choice — now a per-integration policy decision. See the Part 2 design's Printing Press section.

## Reproduction

```bash
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/mvanhorn/printing-press-library.git
# OAuth self-refresh examples:
sed -n '1,60p'   library/productivity/outlook-calendar/internal/oauth/device.go
sed -n '95,135p' library/productivity/figma/internal/cli/auth.go
# env-override convention (every CLI):
grep -rn "Env-var token wins" library/*/*/internal/config/config.go
```

Scratch clone used for this spike: `/tmp/pp-spike/printing-press-library` (safe to delete).
